metaTitle: Request Membership Consideration | CEO Elite Circle

hero.title: Request Membership Consideration
hero.intro: Membership is by invitation and consideration. Share your details below and the Circle will be in touch.

form.consentLabel: I have read and agree to the Privacy policy
form.note: Your details go straight to the Circle. Sending this begins consideration; it does not confirm membership, and someone will be in touch about what follows.

selection.title: How consideration works
selection.intro: Five steps, from first enquiry to invitation. How long each takes varies with the enquiry, and is not fixed to a schedule.

steps.title: Enquiry
steps.body: You write, or a member writes on your behalf. Either route is considered on the same footing.

steps.title: First conversation
steps.body: An unhurried discussion about what you are working on and what you would want from the membership. There is nothing to prepare.

steps.title: Interview
steps.body: A longer conversation with members of the Circle. It runs in both directions: you are assessing the fit as much as we are.

steps.title: Review
steps.body: Your candidacy is considered within the Circle. The question is whether the room is right for you and you for it, rather than whether you are qualified.

steps.title: Acceptance
steps.body: Where consideration is favourable, an invitation follows with the terms of membership. Where it is not, you are told directly.
